text:
violet: quick sync—RFC follow-up on "fallback cost accounting". main question: when we route to cheaper model during quota pressure, who pays the cost and how do we reflect it in billing/quotas?

samir: good Q. options: (A) attribute to original tenant and decrement their token budget at full cost-equivalent, (B) attribute to tenant but at discounted rate, (C) attribute to a global 'fallback pool' charged to infra budget for first N fallbacks per minute.

hao: operationally C is simplest for rollout but hides usage. product will want per-tenant visibility. maybe hybrid: infra absorbs first X fallbacks/hour per-tenant then remainder counted to tenant.

anna: UX implications: customers need to know when they're being downgraded. propose structured hint in response: `{"fallback": "model-legacy-small", "billing_delta": "-0.6"}` and Console shows accumulated fallback minutes.

violet: technical: admission path should mark request metadata `fallback_candidate=true` before routing. router emits `fallback_decision` event with `reason` and `cost_delta`.

samir: fairness concern: expensive tenants could offload cost by routing low-priority traffic to cheaper variants and inflate usage. need a policy to prevent systematic abuse—e.g., only allow fallback for requests under certain priority or if abuse_score > threshold.

hao: metrics to collect: per-tenant `fallback_rate`, `fallback_cost`, `fallback_success` (did quality drop?), and `fallback_revert` (did user retry causing double cost). Also histogram of latency delta between primary vs fallback.

infra-bot: perf run summary: https://ci.company/perm/fallback-accounting/exp-3 — 0.8% overall cost reduction, but 12% increase in billing reporting lag due to event fanout

anna: rollout plan: shadow-mode events with billing delta tags for 48h, then pilot on internal tenants. need a support playbook for disputed billing cases.

violet: implementation notes: router emits events to kafka topic `fallbacks`, billing job consumes and updates per-tenant counters with eventual consistency. we must document eventual consistency window in Console.

samir: ACLs—private deployments must keep fallback accounting in customer-owned DB. design should support pluggable sink.

hao: fallback selection algorithm: prefer smaller-model variant with highest predicted BLEU/accuracy retention. ML team will provide a ranking function; router scores candidates in <5ms budget.

anna: testing: simulate adversary that intentionally triggers fallbacks to exploit discounts. validate hybrid absorb-first-N policy limits abuse.

violet: legal: ensure fallback logs don't leak prompt contents in staging. sync with security for redaction rules.

samir: can we add a header `X-Redwood-Fallback: model=redwood-lite; cost_delta=0.4` for observability? Anna: yes but redact in logs.

violet: ok action items: Hao to wire kafka topic + scoring call; Samir to draft policy for hybrid absorb; Anna to mock Console widgets; I'll add rollout draft. PR expected in 72h.

infra-bot: created INFRA-2021: "fallback-cost-accounting" checklist https://infra-tracker/INFRA-2021

anna: thanks all — ping when PR ready

violet: closing thread
